title: Silent together, restless apart
odia: ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନ କହେ, ନ ଦେଖିଲେ ପାଣି ନ ପିଏ
literal_meaning: On meeting, says nothing; without seeing, will not drink water.
explanation: The contradiction is the joke: someone seems distant in person but cannot settle when the other is absent.
meaning_odia: ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଥିଲେ କଥା କହୁନାହାନ୍ତି, ଦୂରେ ଗଲେ ମନ ଥୟ ହେଉନାହିଁ। ବାହାରର ଦୂରତା ଓ ଭିତରର ଟାଣର ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସରେ କଥାଟିର ମଜା। ଏହା ଆଚରଣର ଅମେଳକୁ ଧରେ; ସେହି ମଣିଷର ମନ କଥା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଜାଣିହୋଇଗଲା ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Two friends barely speak during a visit, then immediately ask when they will meet again. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source labels this ଢଗ under meeting. It names no relationship or reason for the silence.

witnesses.wording: ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନ କହେ, ନ ଦେଖିଲେ ପାଣି ନ ପିଏ

variants.locator: Uploaded compilation page26, four-line block beginning ନଡିଆ ଗଛରେ (comparison PDF271–272).
variants.note: Extended source block grouped editorially under this saying because the closing couplet matches; the opening remains unexplained and need not form one narrative. Literal: There are no coconuts on the coconut tree; Dhadia sits with legs stretched out. When not seeing [the other], [someone] pines away; on seeing [the other], [they] do not speak. ଅର୍ଥ: ନଡ଼ିଆ ଗଛରେ ନଡ଼ିଆ ନାହିଁ, ଧଡ଼ିଆ ଗୋଡ଼ ଲମ୍ବାଇ ବସିଛି—ପ୍ରଥମ ଦୁଇ ଧାଡ଼ିର ଚିତ୍ର ଏତିକି। ପରର ଦୁଇ ଧାଡ଼ିରେ ନଦେଖିଲେ ଝୁରିବା, ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନକହିବାର ଅମେଳ ଅଛି। ଏହି ଶେଷ ଭାବଟି ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଥିବା ଢଗର ସମାନ। ଧଡ଼ିଆ ନାମ କି ପତଳା ଲୋକର ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା, ଏବଂ ପ୍ରଥମ ଚିତ୍ର ସହ ଶେଷ ଭାବର ସମ୍ପର୍କ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନୁହେଁ। Explanation: The closing couplet shares the established saying’s contrast between longing in absence and silence in someone’s presence. The coconut-tree scene is preserved because all four lines appear in one visual block in the upload. That adjacency does not establish a single narrative or explain how the opening relates to the ending. Dhadia retains the source designation; thin or slender person is a possible lexical alternative. No coconut-tree moral, romantic relationship or identity between the figures is supplied. Source: uploaded compilation page26, inspected17November2026; exact four lines retained without repair. Source quotation excluded from collection CC licensing; upload licence unknown.

english_summary: Someone stays silent in the other’s presence but cannot settle when they are apart.
